title: Blog Post to Podcast
summary: Pick one of three voices, approve the script, and get your post back as a podcast episode with intro music, a transcript, show notes, a LinkedIn post and an optional 45-second clip.
outcome: Turn a post or newsletter into a narrated episode in your chosen voice, with intro music, show notes, a LinkedIn post and a short clip. You approve the script before anything is spent.
boundary: It doesn't publish anything, host a podcast feed or post to LinkedIn; get past paywalls or logins; narrate a post you may not use; or spend anything before you approve the script, voice and maximum cost. The clip is made only when your computer can draw captions.

catalog_tools.purpose: Read the approved script aloud in the chosen voice, or as a two-voice conversation (the expressive model, used by default).
Read the approved script in one voice for about half the price when the user picks the fast model.
Make the music for the 5-second intro and outro sting.

inputs: Your post: a public link, pasted text or a file (required)
Voice: Warm, Calm or Deep (default: Warm)

Episode: a spoken edit of the whole post, written for listening, up to about 6 minutes (default), or the exact text read verbatim; for longer posts a faithful excerpt or a 2-minute summary; or a two-voice conversation
Names or terms to pronounce carefully (default: none; the agent flags likely ones)
Show name for the intro and show notes (default: the blog or newsletter name)
outputs: episode.mp3: your post read aloud, with a 5-second intro and outro sting and no music under the speech
transcript.md: the approved script with timestamps
show-notes.md: a summary, key points, the link to the post and a note that the voice is AI
linkedin-post.md: a LinkedIn post ready to paste
clip-45s.mp4: an optional 45-second captioned clip, made only when your computer can render it

cost.model: Narration is charged per character and the intro music per minute, at the prices Scrollport shows just before the quote. Joining, loudness, the transcript, show notes, LinkedIn post and clip are made on your computer at no cost.
cost.notes: At list prices inspected on 14 October 2026 (expressive voice $0.14 per 1,000 characters, fast voice $0.07, music $0.21 per minute), 90 seconds of narration plans to about $0.20 and five minutes to about $0.60; the approved maximum adds a re-take of the longest part. Eleven v3 has settled at about 22% of its list price, so a five-minute episode typically costs about $0.15; the 14 October verification spent $0.17 on a six-minute episode. The fast voice roughly halves the narration part. Trial-safe: a two-minute episode (at most 1,900 narration characters and one 7-second music request) stays within $0.60, re-take included.

approvals: Approve the script, voice and maximum cost, shown together in one message, before any paid run; the approval time is recorded before the first run
Hear the first paragraph and say it sounds right before the rest is recorded; with no answer, the run stops and waits
Approve again after any change to the script, voice, model or length, and before any spend above the approved maximum
Approve in your Scrollport wallet any run that Scrollport holds for confirmation
compatibility: Agent Skills host with local files; ships in the OpenAI plugin, because Anthropic's plugin directory excludes audio generation
One Scrollport connection (CLI, MCP or HTTP) that can search, inspect, run and read the wallet
ffmpeg and ffprobe to join the parts, trim the music and set loudness; without them the parts are returned in order
An ffmpeg build with the subtitles and showwaves filters and libx264 for the optional clip
